Simple purées

Mango purée

Mangópüré

6 months+ Sound idea 10 min 2 portions

Serve on a spoon so it does not slide. A few teaspoons is enough for a first taste.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 180 g ripe mango (flesh only, peeled and cut off the stone)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Choose a ripe mango that gives slightly when pressed.
  2. Peel it and cut the flesh off the stone.
  3. Trim away stringy fibre.
  4. Blend until smooth.
  5. Do not cook it, and do not add sugar.

Sound idea

Mango purée is slippery, and thick pieces slide off a spoon. Cooking a ripe mango is unnecessary.

Blend ripe mango and serve it on a spoon. A ripe mango needs no cooking and no sugar.
